sentences.zh: 于是他们穿过这种狂风暴雨和暴风雪继续航行。

sentences.en: And on the 19th of March, they reach the northern tip of Jutland, which is called the Score.
sentences.zh: 3月19日，他们到达了日德兰半岛的最北端，被称为斯卡恩。

sentences.en: And here they hear news that Britain's negotiating team has been expelled from Denmark.
sentences.zh: 在这里，他们听到消息说英国的谈判小组已被丹麦驱逐。

sentences.en: So there's no doubt now it is war.
sentences.zh: 所以现在毫无疑问，战争开始了。

sentences.en: So Admiral Parker sends a message home.
sentences.zh: 于是帕克海军上将发回了一条消息。

sentences.en: He says, we will head around the tip of Jutland right away, and I will put the orders into execution.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们将立即绕过日德兰半岛的尖端，我将执行命令。

sentences.en: So round they go.
sentences.zh: 于是他们绕了过去。

sentences.en: And three days later, by the 22nd of March, they're approaching the town of Helsingur, better known as Elsinore, which is in the shadow of this great castle.
sentences.zh: 三天后，即3月22日，他们接近了赫尔辛格镇，也就是更广为人知的埃尔西诺，它就在这座大城堡的阴影下。

sentences.en: One of the best gift shops I've ever been to in a castle.
sentences.zh: 这是我去过的城堡里礼品店最好的之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a brilliant castle and a great gift shop.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是一座很棒的城堡，还有一个很棒的礼品店。

sentences.en: And of course, this is famous in England as the setting for Shakespeare's play Hamlet.
sentences.zh: 当然，这在英国很有名，因为它是莎士比亚戏剧《哈姆雷特》的背景。

sentences.en: And the salient thing about Hamlet,
sentences.zh: 而关于哈姆雷特最突出的事情，

sentences.en: Dominic, is that he delays.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，就是他拖延了。

sentences.en: And is there anyone in this story who delays much to the impatience of Nelson?
sentences.zh: 在这个故事里，有没有人像纳尔逊那样因为拖延而感到不耐烦？

sentences.en: That's a very nice Shakespearean segue.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常好的莎士比亚式的过渡。

sentences.en: I applaud that.
sentences.zh: 我为你鼓掌。

sentences.en: I applaud that.
sentences.zh: 我为你鼓掌。

sentences.en: That's top quality podcasting.
sentences.zh: 那是顶级质量的播客。

sentences.en: Because right here,
sentences.zh: 因为就在这里，

sentences.en: Admiral Parker stops.
sentences.zh: 帕克海军上将停了下来。

sentences.en: He hesitates.
sentences.zh: 他犹豫了。

sentences.en: And the wind is with them.
sentences.zh: 而且风向对他们有利。

sentences.en: So why has he stopped?
sentences.zh: 那么他为什么要停下来？

sentences.en: The answer is he's received terrifying new intelligence about the Danish defences.
sentences.zh: 答案是他收到了关于丹麦防御工事的恐怖新情报。

sentences.en: Copenhagen is already going to be a very tough nut to crack.
sentences.zh: 哥本哈根已经是一个非常难啃的骨头了。

sentences.en: The water is very shallow.
sentences.zh: 水非常浅。

sentences.en: And to get in an attacking fleet, to get into the harbour, we'll have to go around this great shoal or sandbank called the Middle Ground.
sentences.zh: 要让进攻舰队进入港口，必须绕过这个被称为“中间地带”的大浅滩或沙洲。

sentences.en: But Parker hears that the harbour entrance is guarded by these huge citadel batteries.
sentences.zh: 但帕克听说港口入口由这些巨大的堡垒炮台守卫。

sentences.en: There's two enormous forks that are built on wooden piles above the sea.
sentences.zh: 有两个巨大的堡垒建在海上的木桩上。

sentences.en: They've got 100 guns each.
sentences.zh: 它们各有100门大炮。

sentences.en: And the Danes have lined the inner channel because they know the British are coming with warships and hulks and floating sort of gun platforMs.
sentences.zh: 丹麦人已经在内航道排好了阵势，因为他们知道英国人带着军舰、废船和浮动炮台来了。

sentences.en: Which means that basically as you sail into the harbour, there's a wall of guns pointing right at you.
sentences.zh: 这意味着基本上当你驶入港口时，有一堵炮墙正对着你。

sentences.en: I mean, to sail into that would be madness.
sentences.zh: 我是说，驶入那种地方简直是疯了。

sentences.en: It would effectively be suicide.
sentences.zh: 那实际上等同于自杀。

sentences.en: What lunatic would conceive of doing that?
sentences.zh: 哪个疯子会想出这种主意？

sentences.en: But exactly.
sentences.zh: 但正是如此。

sentences.en: Who indeed?
sentences.zh: 到底是谁呢？

sentences.en: Parker thinks, no, we'll just stop.
sentences.zh: 帕克想，不，我们还是停下来吧。

sentences.en: And Nelson can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: And for two days, he smoulders in his cabin aboard the St. George's ship.
sentences.zh: 两天来，他在圣乔治号的船舱里闷闷不乐。

sentences.en: And he's still writing letters to Emma.
sentences.zh: 他还在给艾玛写信。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: He's thinking about the Prince of Wales and thinking about throwing boiling water over people's heads and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他还在想威尔士亲王，还在想把滚烫的水泼在别人头上之类的事。

sentences.en: And then he writes Parker this extraordinary letter.
sentences.zh: 然后他给帕克写了这封非同寻常的信。

sentences.en: He says, don't worry about the defences.
sentences.zh: 他说，别担心防御工事。

sentences.en: You know, time is of the essence.
sentences.zh: 你知道，时间紧迫。

sentences.en: It's now or never.
sentences.zh: 机不可失，时不再来。

sentences.en: We have to strike at the Danes.
sentences.zh: 我们必须打击丹麦人。

sentences.en: Not a moment should be loSt.
sentences.zh: 一刻也不应耽误。

sentences.en: This is a quote in Attack in the Enemy.
sentences.zh: 这是“进攻敌人”中的一句名言。

sentences.en: They will every day and every hour be stronger.
sentences.zh: 他们每一天每一小时都会变得更强大。

sentences.en: And then he says to Parker, the honour of England is in your hands.
sentences.zh: 然后他对帕克说，英国的荣誉掌握在你的手中。

sentences.en: On your decision depends whether our country shall be degraded in the eyes of Europe or whether she shall rear her head higher than ever.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家在欧洲眼中是蒙羞还是能比以往更高地昂起头，全取决于你的决定。

sentences.en: Never did our country depend so much on the success of any fleet as on this.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家从未像现在这样依赖任何舰队的成功。

sentences.en: And he sends the letter across to Parker's flagship.
sentences.zh: 他把信送到了帕克的旗舰上。

sentences.en: And he waits and waits for the reply.
sentences.zh: 他等待着，等待着回复。

sentences.en: And finally it comes.
sentences.zh: 终于回复来了。

sentences.en: And Parker says, very well, we will attack.
sentences.zh: 帕克说，好吧，我们进攻。

sentences.en: But you, Horatio Nelson, will lead that assault personally.
sentences.zh: 但你，霍雷肖·纳尔逊，将亲自领导那次突击。

sentences.en: We're not going to stop now, are we?
sentences.zh: 我们现在不能停下来，对吧？

sentences.en: We are, Tom.
sentences.zh: 我们会的，汤姆。

sentences.en: That's the nature of podcasting.
sentences.zh: 这就是播客的本质。

sentences.en: Unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 难以置信。

sentences.en: Britain's survival is at stake.
sentences.zh: 英国的生存危在旦夕。

sentences.en: The Danish guns are bristling.
sentences.zh: 丹麦的大炮严阵以待。

sentences.en: Nelson's preparing to go into the strait.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊正准备进入海峡。

sentences.en: Oh, such excitement.
sentences.zh: 哦，真是太令人兴奋了。

sentences.zh: 哥本哈根战役即将开始。
